keyFiles.what: The pairing list — one entry per paired sandbox, and the reason a computer can sync a fleet.
The CLI: setup adds a pairing, status lists them, uninstall drops one or all.
The one resident watcher: walks every pairing per tick, reconciling port forwards.
Session naming and the orphan sweep — what is retired, and what is deliberately left alone.
Why no .git ever file-syncs: commits travel by git's own protocol instead.

name: @intentic/sync
oneLiner: Keeps folders on your computer in step with your sandboxes.
